freigaben.begruendung: Built while loading from BIOME_NAMEN (a literal list that moves along) and BIOM_TON (a literal table of ./design, a module without imports). In the old state it was evaluated after the two top-level awaits that load the registries, now before them. It reads no registry, so the two awaits cannot change its value.

The statements named hand `seiteBauen`, `pruefberichtBauen`, `weltSektionBauen` (which reach this name) to `erzeugeEditorKern` as values and register event listeners whose callbacks call them. `erzeugeEditorKern` (werkzeuge/kontext.ts) only stores the host functions and calls `host.seiteBauen()` and its siblings inside its own closures (`alles`, the tool hooks), never while it is being built; an event callback runs after the module has loaded. That holds because the module has exactly one top-level await pair, at lines 197 and 198 of editorMain.ts, in front of the first of these statements (line 574): from line 574 to the old place of the name (lines 1863 to 1867) the module runs without a break, so no event and no microtask can run in between (checked with a search for `await` at the start of a line in the old state 88ceb5e1). So `seitenHost` is initialised before any of these functions runs, in the old and in the new order.

So `hinweisZeile` is initialised before any of these functions runs, in the old and in the new order.

The module came with a merge of main that lies between the two states (the head contains main 88ceb5e1); it is not part of this step. With the merged main commit as the old state the finding does not exist (manifest e1.json).
